frequency_question: How often do central banks implement incremental reserve ratio requirements without prior public signaling?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory notification by a major emerging market central bank altering reserve requirements specifically for liquidity management within a defined operational window; excludes permanent statutory changes to baseline reserve ratios.
provenance_note: claims 25 cases from only 7 named (3.6x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 7 named; estimated roughly 25 total comparable policy interventions globally in similar liquidity stress regimes.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller frontier economies with infrequent statutory adjustments.
skeleton: Central bank liquidity adjustment cycles since 2005, categorized by whether unexpected surplus conditions triggered unscheduled regulatory absorption tools.
multiplier: 7 documented instances of unexpected or semi-signalled liquidity absorption tools deployed across major emerging market jurisdictions out of 25 observed liquidity tightening episodes.
validity_reason: Central bank operational frameworks for liquidity management evolve slowly over multi-year structural horizons.
